title: cuscuta epithymum var. scabrella
intro: Cuscuta epithymum var. scabrella, commonly known as Dodder or Bird's-eye Cuscuta, is a parasitic plant species belonging to the family Convolvulaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly for its ability to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Cuscuta epithymum var. scabrella include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve wound healing, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
